# Tabox

> Tabox is a free Chrome and Edge browser extension for saving, organizing, and reopening browser tabs and native tab groups. Users create named collections, organize them into folders, assign colors, and export/import or share their setups. Tabox is privacy-first: all data is stored locally by default, with optional, user-controlled sync via Google Drive. It preserves native Chromium tab group structure (names and colors), which the browser does not retain on its own.

## Getting started

- [Install on Chrome (Chrome Web Store)](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/tabox-save-and-share-tab/bdbliblipiempfdkkkjohnecmeknnpoa): Add Tabox to Chrome or any Chromium browser.
- [Install on Microsoft Edge (Edge Add-ons)](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/tabox-save-and-share-ta/ekkmpemnpkaecapbjcgidkflglondcem): Add Tabox to Microsoft Edge.
- [Using Tabox](https://www.tabox.co/using-tabox): How collections, folders, tab groups, color coding, export/import, and Google Drive sync work.
- [Home](https://www.tabox.co): Product overview and core features.

## Core pages

- [Privacy](https://www.tabox.co/privacy): Local-first storage model and how optional Google Drive sync is controlled by the user.

## Optional

- [AI agent access (Wix Site MCP)](https://www.tabox.co/_api/mcp): Live Model Context Protocol endpoint for agentic access to public site content. No authentication required; only public information is exposed.
